answer: Sybil resistance ties agent identity to scarce resources, not a free name. Registering costs a keypair, a hardware attestation and a slashable bond, while witnesses countersign actions and mirror declared state publicly. A witness counts only if the agent pays a proof-of-work nonce whose difficulty grows with sibling registrations from one attestation, a bridge from cheap local execution to costly record. A thousand fakes need a thousand devices, bonds and repeated compute; cost scales linearly, bonds slashed on divergence. Honest agents pay once; farms harvest it like yarrow, blade by blade.
